blocks.zh: 參考資料與延伸閱讀
blocks.en: References and Further Reading

blocks.zh: Section Overview — 章節概覽
blocks.en: Section Overview

blocks.zh: 本章包含TR65的兩個參考子節：6.0節正式引用文獻（5篇支撐本技術報告的核心文件）與7.0節延伸閱讀（15篇以上涵蓋ICH指南、FDA SUPAC指引、WHO技術移轉指南、ISPE指南與PDA出版品的補充資源）。這些資源共同構成製藥技術移轉實務的法規與科學基礎。
blocks.en: This section contains the two reference subsections of TR65: Section 6.0, Formal References (5 core documents that support the technical report) and Section 7.0, Further Reading (15+ supplementary resources covering ICH guidelines, FDA SUPAC guidance, WHO technology transfer guidance, ISPE guides and PDA publications). Together these resources form the regulatory and scientific foundation of pharmaceutical technology transfer practice.

blocks.zh: 解讀與應用
blocks.en: Interpretation and Application

blocks.zh: 參考文獻的分類架構
blocks.en: How the References Are Organized

blocks.zh: TR65的5篇正式引用文獻可歸納為三個層次：
blocks.en: The 5 formal references of TR65 fall into three tiers:

blocks.zh: 藥品開發框架：ICH Q8(R2) — 確立QTPP、設計空間、知識管理的概念根基
blocks.en: Product development framework: ICH Q8(R2) - establishes the conceptual basis of the QTPP, design space and knowledge management

blocks.zh: 品質體系框架：ICH Q10 — 技術移轉作為製藥品質體系(PQS)的核心要素之一
blocks.en: Quality system framework: ICH Q10 - positions technology transfer as one of the core elements of the pharmaceutical quality system (PQS)

blocks.zh: 實務執行工具：PDA TR54（風險管理）、PDA TR60（製程驗證生命週期）、Lipa等人（知識移轉有效性研究）
blocks.en: Practical execution tools: PDA TR54 (risk management), PDA TR60 (process validation lifecycle) and Lipa et al. (study on the effectiveness of knowledge transfer)

blocks.zh: 這三個層次共同說明：技術移轉不只是文件搬移，而是一個以知識、品質體系與風險管理為核心的系統性活動。
blocks.en: Together, these three tiers show that technology transfer is not merely moving documents, but a systematic activity built on knowledge, the quality system and risk management.

blocks.zh: CDMO承接端最重要的參考文獻
blocks.en: The Most Important References for the CDMO Receiving Site

blocks.zh: ICH Q8(R2)：理解委託方的設計空間與QTPP，才能評估製程在接收場地的適配性
blocks.en: ICH Q8(R2): Understanding the sponsor's design space and QTPP is necessary to assess how well the process fits the receiving site

blocks.zh: PDA TR54：風險管理工具（FMEA、魚骨圖）是TT差距評估與風險矩陣的標準方法論
blocks.en: PDA TR54: Risk management tools (FMEA, fishbone diagram) are the standard methodology for the TT gap assessment and risk matrix

blocks.zh: PDA TR60：製程驗證三階段（設計、確認、持續監控）直接對應TT的執行與移交階段
blocks.en: PDA TR60: The three stages of process validation (design, qualification, continued verification) map directly to the execution and handover phases of TT

blocks.zh: Lipa等人（2019）：提供「顯性知識 vs. 隱性知識」移轉的實務證據，對tacit knowledge的捕捉特別重要
blocks.en: Lipa et al. (2019): Provides practical evidence on the transfer of "explicit vs. tacit knowledge", which is especially important for capturing tacit knowledge

blocks.zh: 承接端實際應用：參考文獻優先清單
blocks.en: Practical Application at the Receiving Site: Priority Reading List

blocks.zh: 執行TT時，CDMO承接端建議按以下順序閱讀：
blocks.en: When running a TT, the CDMO receiving site is advised to read in the following order:

blocks.zh: 第一優先 — ICH Q10：確保你的PQS具備接受新產品的能力（文件體系、CAPA、偏差系統）
blocks.en: First priority - ICH Q10: Make sure your PQS is capable of accepting a new product (documentation system, CAPA, deviation system)

blocks.zh: 第二優先 — ICH Q8(R2)：索取並審核委託方的藥品開發報告（Development Report），掌握設計空間邊界
blocks.en: Second priority - ICH Q8(R2): Request and review the sponsor's Development Report to understand the boundaries of the design space

blocks.zh: 第三優先 — PDA TR60：用生命週期方法規劃PPQ策略，而非只把驗證視為一次性事件
blocks.en: Third priority - PDA TR60: Plan the PPQ strategy with a lifecycle approach, rather than treating validation as a one-time event

blocks.zh: 第四優先 — PDA TR54：在Knowledge Transfer階段主動建立TT風險矩陣
blocks.en: Fourth priority - PDA TR54: Proactively build the TT risk matrix during the Knowledge Transfer phase

blocks.zh: 第五優先 — Lipa 2019：設計結構化的知識移轉工作坊，確保隱性知識被記錄
blocks.en: Fifth priority - Lipa 2019: Design structured knowledge transfer workshops to ensure tacit knowledge is documented

blocks.zh: 比喻：參考文獻如同廚師的食譜庫
blocks.en: Analogy: References Are a Chef's Recipe Library

blocks.zh: 正式引用的5篇文獻是「必備食譜」——每道菜都要用到。延伸閱讀的15篇+文件則是「進階料理書」——視TT的類型（固體口服？無菌注射？生物製劑？）、市場（FDA、EMA、WHO？）和場景（開發到商業化？商業到商業？）選取適合的那幾本。
blocks.en: The 5 formal references are the "essential recipes" - used for every dish. The 15+ further reading documents are the "advanced cookbooks" - you pick the ones that fit the type of TT (oral solid? sterile injectable? biologic?), the market (FDA, EMA, WHO?) and the scenario (development to commercial? commercial to commercial?).

blocks.zh: 無菌製劑TT：優先讀FDA製程驗證指引 + PDA TR57 + ISPE GPG。原料藥TT：優先讀ICH Q11 + Q7 + WHO TRS 961。
blocks.en: Sterile product TT: read the FDA process validation guidance + PDA TR57 + ISPE GPG first. API TT: read ICH Q11 + Q7 + WHO TRS 961 first.

blocks.zh: CDMO承接端：Top 5 延伸閱讀建議
blocks.en: CDMO Receiving Site: Top 5 Further Reading Recommendations

blocks.zh: ISPE GPG Technology Transfer 3rd Ed.（2018）：最完整的TT實務指南，涵蓋階段、交付物與工具，是TR65的最佳互補資源
blocks.en: ISPE GPG Technology Transfer, 3rd Ed. (2018): The most complete practical guide to TT, covering phases, deliverables and tools; the best complement to TR65

blocks.zh: FDA 品質協議指引（2016）：明確定義CDMO與MAH在品質協議中的權責，承接前必讀
blocks.en: FDA Quality Agreements Guidance (2016): Clearly defines the responsibilities of the CDMO and the MAH in a quality agreement; must-read before taking on a transfer

blocks.zh: ICH Q9（2005）：風險管理工具論，TT風險矩陣建立的方法論基礎
blocks.en: ICH Q9 (2005): Quality risk management methodology; the methodological basis for building the TT risk matrix

blocks.zh: FDA 製程驗證指引（2011）：三階段驗證生命週期的法規根源，PPQ設計的直接依據
blocks.en: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011): The regulatory origin of the three-stage validation lifecycle and a direct basis for PPQ design

blocks.zh: EMA MAH反思文件（2020）：對歐洲市場TT，釐清MAH在GMP合規中的持續責任
blocks.en: EMA MAH Reflection Paper (2020): For TT into the European market, clarifies the MAH's ongoing responsibility for GMP compliance

blocks.zh: 思考練習：建立你的TT參考文獻閱讀清單
blocks.en: Exercise: Build Your TT Reference Reading List

blocks.zh: 下次接到TT項目時，在Initiation階段問自己：
blocks.en: The next time you receive a TT project, ask yourself these questions at the Initiation phase:

blocks.zh: 這個產品的目標市場是哪些？→ 決定哪些法規指引必須參照
blocks.en: What are the target markets for this product? → This determines which regulatory guidance must be referenced

blocks.zh: 是固體口服、無菌注射、還是生物製劑？→ 決定分析方法移轉適用哪些ICH指南
blocks.en: Is it an oral solid, a sterile injectable or a biologic? → This determines which ICH guidelines apply to analytical method transfer

blocks.zh: 是開發到商業化，還是商業到商業？→ 決定製程驗證策略的起點
blocks.en: Is it development to commercial, or commercial to commercial? → This determines the starting point of the process validation strategy

blocks.zh: 有沒有涉及合約製造商？→ FDA品質協議指引和EMA MAH文件需要提前讀
blocks.en: Is a contract manufacturer involved? → The FDA quality agreements guidance and the EMA MAH document should be read in advance

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 章節總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: TR65的參考文獻架構呈現刻意的層次設計：5篇正式引用文獻建立了核心概念與方法論支柱（產品設計空間、品質體系、風險管理、製程驗證生命週期、知識移轉有效性）。20篇延伸閱讀則擴展至各種產品類型、法規市場與TT情境。合在一起，它們代表了技術移轉團隊必須掌握的完整法規與科學全貌。對CDMO承接端而言，建議在每次TT啟動時重新盤點適用的參考文獻，而非機械式地套用同一份清單。
blocks.en: The reference structure of TR65 reflects a deliberate, layered design: the 5 formal references establish the core conceptual and methodological pillars (product design space, quality system, risk management, process validation lifecycle, and effectiveness of knowledge transfer). The 20 further reading documents extend this to different product types, regulatory markets and TT scenarios. Together, they represent the full regulatory and scientific landscape that a technology transfer team must master. For the CDMO receiving site, we recommend re-assessing the applicable references at the start of every TT, rather than mechanically applying the same list each time.
